Shape of the transition weight and the relationship between the two accessibility
measures.

## Setup

```{python}
import sys

sys.path.append("..")

import os
import numpy as np

from data_processing import load_and_prepare_data, preprocess_data
from models import optimize_utility_model
from accessibility import process_accessibility_data
from si_plots import plot_transition_weights, plot_accessibility_scatters
```

## Configuration

```{python}
FIGS_DIR = "../../figs/SI"
os.makedirs(FIGS_DIR, exist_ok=True)

CITY_ORDER = ["Bay Area", "Los Angeles", "Mexico City", "Rio de Janeiro"]

CITY_PATHS = {
    "Bay Area": ("../../data/h3_bay_8.geojson", "../../data/bay_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Los Angeles": ("../../data/h3_la_8.geojson", "../../data/la_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Mexico City": ("../../data/h3_cdmx_8.geojson", "../../data/cdmx_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Rio de Janeiro": ("../../data/map_informality_eci.geojson", "../../data/rio_flows_h3_8h3.csv"),
}
```

## Load Data and Fit WorkReach

```{python}
all_city_data = {}
all_models = {}

for city, (mzn_path, flows_path) in CITY_PATHS.items():
    aligned, mzn, dist_m, eci_m, flows_m, home_m, inf_m, _ = load_and_prepare_data(
        mzn_path, flows_path, city
    )
    median_informality = mzn["informality_rate"].median()
    aligned["informality_level"] = np.where(
        aligned["informality_rate"] < median_informality, "Low", "High"
    )

    (distance, distance_log, eci, flows, informality, home_population, work_population,
     distance_min, distance_diff, eci_min, eci_diff) = preprocess_data(
        home_m, dist_m, eci_m, flows_m, inf_m
    )

    all_city_data[city] = {
        "aligned_data": aligned, "mzn": mzn, "distance_matrix": dist_m,
        "distance": distance, "distance_log": distance_log, "eci": eci,
        "flows": flows, "informality": informality,
        "home_population": home_population, "work_population": work_population,
        "distance_min": distance_min, "distance_diff": distance_diff,
    }

    params, predictions = optimize_utility_model(
        distance_log, eci, flows, informality, home_population, True, city
    )
    all_models[city] = {"Utility": (params, predictions, 5)}
```

## Transition Weight

```{python}
params_by_city = {city: all_models[city]["Utility"][0] for city in CITY_ORDER}
scaling_by_city = {
    city: (all_city_data[city]["distance_diff"], all_city_data[city]["distance_min"])
    for city in CITY_ORDER
}

fig = plot_transition_weights(CITY_ORDER, params_by_city, scaling_by_city)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/transition_all.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```

## Accessibility Measures

```{python}
combined_accessibility_df, _ = process_accessibility_data(all_city_data, all_models)

fig = plot_accessibility_scatters(combined_accessibility_df, CITY_ORDER)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/accessibility_scatter_only.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```
